meta.rule: per outer fold: inner leave-one-level-out on outer training rows along the same axis; pick LawGP if inner pooled R2 (global denominator on outer training rows) of LawGP > GP; axis verdict = majority of fold picks (ties -> GP)
meta.truth: outer pooled leave-one-level-out R2 gain LawGP - GP: helps > 0.02, hurts < -0.02, else neutral
meta.twin_note: synthetic grids from a6_twin.response surfaces with a6_twin.spec_mult specimen multipliers and a1 cycle-averaging noise; not the a6 waveform simulator (E1's waveform twin)
meta.truth_note: truth = realized outer leave-one-level-out gain (LawGP - GP pooled R2) on the same data, for synthetic grids too; it is not the generator's truth (the known response surface is never used for scoring)
